description: A false-color satellite image displaying a landscape primarily composed of rectangular plots of land in a deep red hue, indicating healthy vegetation. A small, bright green point is centrally located, likely representing a sampling point for land cover validation. In the mid-right, darker, irregular shapes suggest structures or sparse trees. A narrow, dark linear feature, possibly a road or canal, traverses the image diagonally, and a dark body of water is visible in the bottom-left corner. This image is a schematic representation of managed (improved) grasslands, characteristic of satellite imagery used in land cover monitoring programs like the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) or LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area Frame Survey).
